Video.summary: The Four winners of the heats face each other in two eliminators, a play-off and a final battle between the two remaining robots. Only the most ferocious robot will be able to call themselves, the New Blood Champions.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - New Blood Grand Final

Video.summary: A champion will emerge for each weight class battling in this Robot Rampage. Including Antweight, Middleweight, Lightweight and Featherweight.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - Robot Rampage

Video.summary: A battle for one of the most prized robot wars possessions, the challenge belt. Challengers must defeat each other and take on the current holders, Tornado, if they are to claim it for themselves.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - Challenge Belt

Video.summary: The ladies take over in this episode. Wives, girlfriends, mothers and sisters pilot the robots for this event. Battling through two rounds and a final, one robot will be crowned Iron Maiden Champion.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - Iron Maidens

Video.summary: Six robots, each representing a different university or college enter the arena. The house robots are have prepared a very valuable lecture for their new class.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - University Challenge

Video.summary: Robots from Australia, Cyprus, Scotland, England, South Africa, Wales, Canada and Northern Ireland battle in the arena to prove who is the best mechanical combatant in the Commonwealth.
Video.title: Extreme 2 - Commonwealth Championships

Video.summary: Eight robots from seven different countries battle each other for the title European Champions, including the reigning World Champions and the UK Champions. Will they be able to add another championship title to their collection?
Video.title: Extreme 2 - European Championship

Video.summary: The Extreme series begins with a vengeance battle to settle a bitter rivalry. Two All-stars battles to put the fan favourites up against each other and a final battle with the Challenge belt at stake to up the pressure for the competitors.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 1

Video.summary: This action-packed episode features several battles, including Wild Card Warriors, Middleweight Championship and Vengeance. All building up to the main event; Mayhem Battle, where three veterans fight for glory.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 2

Video.summary: The battles this episode include; All-stars, another Mayhem battle and the Challenge belt. Robots from the UK, USA, The Netherlands and Germany fight for your entertainment and their pride in International Inferno.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 3

Video.summary: A rivalry will be settled in tonight’s main event, a vengeance battle between Razer and Pussycat. Razer claims in their last fight Pussycat had broken a “Gentleman’s Agreement” by causing unnecessary damage after the robot was immobilised.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 4

Video.summary: Tag Team Terror, Mayhem and Vengeance all precede this episode’s main event, a one-off Armed Forces Mayhem. Robots from the British Army, Navy and Royal Air Force go to war to prove who is most efficient in combat.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 5

Video.summary: Two robots fight over the title “Best showman” in this episode’s Vengeance Main Event. In the build-up, we see a three way International Melee between the UK, Belgium and The Netherlands, Tag Team Terror, Challenge Belt and Mayhem battle.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 6

Video.summary: Six robots will be reduced down to one in this annihilator episode. Qualifiers from the Mayhem battles previously in the series. Which competitor will battle through the four rounds and defeat the opposition in the final.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Annihilator 1

Video.summary: Four teams comprised of celebrities and veteran roboteers. Which celebrity has a natural flare for mechanical combat and who will be having words with their agent when they end up in the pit?
Video.title: Battle of the Stars - Episode 1

Video.summary: Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?
Video.title: Battle of the Stars - Episode 2

Video.summary: The Extreme series returns to its normal format after the first Annihilator. Four mixed battles, followed by a Main Event, which in this episode is an All-Stars battle between Pussycat and Stinger.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 8

Video.summary: Shunt and Dead Metal prepare to be let loose from the sidelines in this episodes Main Event, House Robot Rebellion. Three unfortunate competitors will be put into the arena as the House Robots have free reign in this destructive episode.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 9

Video.summary: We have reached the Quarter Finals for the All-Stars battles in this episode’s Main Event and another Mayhem battle puts another three robots up against each other.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 10

Video.summary: Four of the best robots armed with rear-hinged flippers go against each other to prove whose best in Flipper Frenzy. Other battles on the card are the Challenge Belt, Tag Team Terror, Wild Card Warriors and Mayhem battle.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 11

Video.summary: Current World Champions Razer are matched against fierce competitor Firestorm in this All-stars match. Four robots make their way to the arena to take part in the German Melee, with the winner securing a place in the Second World Championship.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 12

Video.summary: The Featherweight Championship takes place in this episode, along with the Challenge Belt, Mayhem battle and more Wildcard Warriors. All these build-up to the Main event, the Tag Team Terror finals.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 13

Video.summary: The second annihilator was supposed to be between the six winners of the mayhem qualifiers, but due to the severity of damage from the battle, two of the robots had to be replaced. Will the two replacements seize this opportunity?
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Annihilator 2

Video.summary: The UK are up against renowned German Engineering in a UK vs Germany battle. Two more rivals have a chance to settle the score in another vengeance battle and other unmissable battles take place before the long awaited All-Stars Grand Final.
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Episode 15

Video.summary: Robots from around the globe ready themselves for the ultimate contest, The Second World Championship. Will lightning strike twice for defending champions Razer, or will they reign be snuffed out by one of the many fierce competitors?
Video.title: Extreme 1 - Second World Championship
